results.content: Tools for modern 3D production workflows. # Trace 3D - Manage your 3D content production workflow in one place. Trace is a production tracking tool built for 3D teams. Assign tasks, review in real time, and design custom workflows—all in one place. We built Trace because 3D content teams were stuck managing production across 5–6 different tools—Slack, spreadsheets, ShotGrid, Jira, email threads… you name it. That constant jumping between platforms slowed teams down and made creative work feel chaotic. With Trace, we’re bringing the entire 3D production pipeline into one place. Unlike Jira or ShotGrid, which were never designed for artists, Trace is built specifically for 3D teams. You can orchestrate your pipeline, track every asset’s stage, and keep your team fully in sync—without losing the creative flow. • Assigning tasks to team members. • Sharing progress for a 3D asset. • Real-time reviews — with revisions, approvals, and progress tracking all in one view. • Create saved views and filters to track every asset and keep projects moving with clarity. • Build milestones, set deadlines, and design custom workflows tailored to your productions. Trace is all about giving 3D artists and studios a modern, purpose-built alternative for managing 3D production workflows, offering clarity, speed, and fewer tools to juggle. results.content:
Title: CRACKER: Track all your crypto assets in one place | Product Hunt
# CRACKER. ## Track all your crypto assets in one place. With CRACKER (Crypto Tracker), you can easily track all your crypto assets. The application allows you to collect all your crypto in one place, dispersed across different blockchains and wallets, and track it in real-time in one convenient interface. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for CRACKER. Already added my main portfolio to Cracker! Will keep an eye on you ;). @alex\_ryazanov We've added the Polygon blockchain! You probably store them in different places: on hardware wallets like Ledger or Trezor, in-browser wallets like Metamask, on cryptocurrency exchanges, mobile wallets like Trust Wallet, and so on. And I thought to myself: it would be great to collect all my cryptocurrencies distributed across different blockchains and wallets in one place and keep track of them! And this should be not an excel spreadsheet, but a convenient web application. So we created the CRACKER. Now you can always know the total balance of your crypto assets and track them in real-time in one place. To add a wallet, select the blockchain and enter the wallet address. All data is automatically taken from the blockchain and the current balance is displayed. Thus, you always see the current balance of all your wallets. CRACKER can be used on all devices: smartphones, tablets, laptops, and desktops. CRACKER works as a web application and you can always access it from your browser, you don't need to install anything. Now CRACKER is in beta testing and you can become early adopters of the project and try it out. The project is actively developing and shortly, we will add: Binance Chain, Cardano, Cosmos, Fantom, XRP, Polygon, Bitcoin Cash, Terra, and others. Also, very convenient features will be added soon: the ability to display NFT tokens and instant balance change notifications. I hope the CRACKER app will help you organize your crypto portfolio. I will be glad to any feedback! To stay in touch with the project team and share feedback, join our Telegram group:  We really appreciate your opinion on the app and it will help us make Cracker even better and more user-friendly!
